# canary edge tests option_buys_after_regime_warning · COLUMNS=80 · colour off
Forward tests
  A forward test is a rule written down before the decisions it is read on: only
  decisions made after the rule was registered count. Canary counts them; the
  reading that turns a full count into an answer is not built yet. In the rules
  about sales, a sale a protection rule sent is read apart from one you chose; a
  stop placed directly at the broker cannot be told apart yet.

Collecting  1 rule

  Do single-name option buys made the session after a Regime warning do better
  or worse than the rest?
    informs buying · checks Regime's stage at the last close
    after a warning          ███▋░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░     6 of 40  +2 not final
    after any other session  ████████▍░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░          14  +3 not final
    group not read yet                                          2
    after a warning also needs 20 separate days: 5 so far
    group not read yet: the fact that places them was not recorded
    final per month ·▅▃█▆ Nov 2026–Mar 2027, at most 8
    counting from 21 Nov 2026 · at this pace about Apr 2028, more than 365
      days out: it cannot fill until counted decisions are kept, which is not
      built yet
    a buy now counts as after a warning: Regime was at early warning at the 19
      Mar close
    counts one contract in one week, final when its position has closed · read
      at 40
    touches no written policy
    registered 2026-11-21 07:00 TZ as rule_1f4b514c8ba19305e2520fd867497e48
    Rule: Single-name option buys that open or add to a long position, made in
      the session after a Regime warning, against all other such buys. A single
      name is any underlying but SPY and VIX. One reading per contract and week,
      final when its position has closed: the average price of the position's
      sales after the buy, zero at expiry, less the price paid, on the contracts
      bought, after the buy's costs. A position closed by delivery gives no
      reading. The figure for each group is the sum of its readings divided by
      the premium paid for them. The label is Regime's stage of the session
      before the buy: warning is early warning, confirmed stress or panic; the
      rest is quiet, stabilization or opportunity. No pass threshold is set for
      this test; it is read by direction in both the earlier and the later half
      of the readings by date. Read once, at 40 final readings after a warning
      session that fall on at least 20 separate days.
